title: 生物风险管理：医院样本

points.K5: 双层包装，吸收材料要够
points.K6: 外包装先消毒，等够时间
points.K9: 运输安保也是生物安保
points.K12: 做核酸的：按规程先灭活
points.K13: 柜内操作，穿好防护，守规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在样本接收窗口旁，手里拿着一个空白标签的样本管模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a sample reception window holding a model sample tube with a blank label.
shots.narration: 医院送来的样本，怎么接、怎么做？
overlay: 生物风险管理：医院样本

shots.scene: 欣欣指向身后的生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a biological safety cabinet behind it.
shots.narration: 今天一步步讲清楚。

shots.scene: 老周在样本接收窗口接过一个黄色运输袋
shots.prompt_en: The older man receives a sealed yellow transport bag at a sample reception window.
shots.narration: 医院送来一袋样本，老周接了过来。

shots.scene: 老周看看运输袋，又看看架子上的培养管，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at the bag and then at culture tubes on a rack, scratching his head.
shots.narration: 他问：这和纯培养物有啥不同？

shots.scene: 王老师走过来，微笑着摆手
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over smiling and waves her hand.
shots.narration: 王老师说：区别可大了。

shots.scene: 王老师指向生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points toward a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 咱们从头说起。

shots.scene: 地图上几条路线从医院、研究所等图标汇到一间实验室
shots.prompt_en: Route lines from a hospital icon and a research institute icon converge on one laboratory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室收的样本，来自不同地方。

shots.scene: 小研在高等级实验室里穿戴整齐，面前是安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in full protective clothing stands in front of a biological safety cabinet in a containment lab.
shots.narration: 高等级实验室的技术人员，样样都要会处理。

shots.scene: 一支培养管里只有一种微生物图标，旁边有对勾
shots.prompt_en: A culture tube containing a single microbe icon with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 研究人员送来的纯培养物，

shots.scene: 培养管旁边放着空白档案卡，上面有放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A blank record card with a magnifier beside the culture tube. No people.
shots.narration: 是什么因子、改过什么，都清楚。

shots.scene: 培养管旁一个台阶图标，其中一级亮起
shots.prompt_en: A four-step staircase icon beside the culture tube with one step lit. No people.
shots.narration: 危险度分组已知，风险很好评估。

shots.scene: 一排样本容器图标：拭子、采血管、尿杯、组织小盒
shots.prompt_en: A row of specimen container icons: a swab, a blood tube, a urine cup and a small tissue box. No people.
shots.narration: 病人样本，形式五花八门。

shots.scene: 一支采血管里有几种不同形状的微生物图标和问号
shots.prompt_en: A blood tube containing several different microbe shapes and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一管样本里，可能不止一种病原。

shots.scene: 风险刻度表，指针拨到最高
shots.prompt_en: A risk gauge icon with the needle turned to the top. No people.
shots.narration: 所以，按最高风险来对待。

shots.scene: 所有样本管都贴上生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Every sample tube in a rack carries a small biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 每一管，都当作有传染性。

shots.section_title: 双层包装，吸收材料要够
shots.scene: 剖面图：样本管在内袋里，外面再套一层袋，中间是吸水垫
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of packaging: a sample tube inside an inner bag with an absorbent pad, inside a second outer bag. No people.
shots.narration: 运输要双层包装，
overlay: 双层包装，吸收材料要够

shots.section_title: 双层包装，吸收材料要够
shots.scene: 吸水垫吸住漏出的液体
shots.prompt_en: An absorbent pad soaking up a small leak inside the bag. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收材料要够，万一漏了能吸干。

shots.section_title: 双层包装，吸收材料要够
shots.scene: 封口扎带，袋子放进有冷却剂的保温箱
shots.prompt_en: A sealed bag closed with a cable tie placed into an insulated box with coolant packs. No people.
shots.narration: 封好口，放进有冷却剂的箱子运输。

shots.section_title: 外包装先消毒，等够时间
shots.scene: 小研戴手套给外包装喷洒消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves sprays disinfectant on the outer bag.
shots.narration: 收到后，先给外包装消毒。
overlay: 外包装先消毒，等够时间

shots.section_title: 外包装先消毒，等够时间
shots.scene: 计时器图标在倒计时
shots.prompt_en: A timer icon counting down beside the disinfected bag. No people.
shots.narration: 等够作用时间再开，这叫接触时间。

shots.section_title: 外包装先消毒，等够时间
shots.scene: 空白标签的乙醇瓶和三十秒计时器
shots.prompt_en: An ethanol bottle with a blank label next to a stopwatch icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这里用70%乙醇，等30秒。

shots.scene: 样本管上贴着空白条码标签
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube with a blank barcode label. No people.
shots.narration: 样本管要标识清楚。

shots.scene: 病人信息被锁在锁形图标里
shots.prompt_en: A blank patient information card locked inside a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 病人的信息，要保密。

shots.scene: 管口包着一小团白色吸收材料的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a sample tube cap wrapped with a small wad of white absorbent material. No people.
shots.narration: 管口包一小团吸收材料，

shots.scene: 在安全柜里开管，滴液被吸住，手套干净
shots.prompt_en: Inside a biological safety cabinet a tube is opened; drips are caught by the absorbent wad and the gloves stay clean.
shots.narration: 开管时滴下的液体，被它吸住。

shots.scene: 手套沾上液体的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a glove wet with sample liquid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不沾手套，防护就不破。

shots.section_title: 运输安保也是生物安保
shots.scene: 运输箱上锁，旁边一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A locked transport box beside a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 运输安全，也是生物安保。
overlay: 运输安保也是生物安保

shots.section_title: 运输安保也是生物安保
shots.scene: 交接签名的空白单据
shots.prompt_en: A blank handover form with two signature lines being signed. No people.
shots.narration: 包得牢、交接清，不丢不漏。

shots.scene: 医院采样窗口，一名采样人员（用医护十字图标代替）贴标签装袋
shots.prompt_en: At a hospital sampling window, a medical cross icon marks the station where a tube is labeled and bagged. No people.
shots.narration: 采样的一方，要贴好标签、包装好。

shots.scene: 运送员和实验人员两个人形图标都带着盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A courier icon and a lab worker icon, both protected by shields. No people.
shots.narration: 这样运送的人、做实验的人都安全。

shots.scene: 标签和样本管之间画着对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank label and a sample tube linked with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 标签也保证样本不弄错、不失效。

shots.scene: 两条岔路：一条通向培养皿图标，一条通向核酸图标
shots.prompt_en: A road splitting in two: one path leads to a culture dish icon, the other to a DNA icon. No people.
shots.narration: 样本进实验室，分两条路。

shots.scene: 培养皿图标被多层盾牌包围
shots.prompt_en: A culture dish icon surrounded by several layers of shields. No people.
shots.narration: 要培养的，病原会大量增加，

shots.scene: 空白评估表上写着最高等级图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form with the highest level icon circled. No people.
shots.narration: 按活培养物评估，用最严的防护。

shots.section_title: 做核酸的：按规程先灭活
shots.scene: 核酸那条路上，第一站是一个锁住的微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: On the DNA path, the first stop is a microbe icon being locked inactive. No people.
shots.narration: 做核酸检测的，先灭活。
overlay: 做核酸的：按规程先灭活

shots.section_title: 做核酸的：按规程先灭活
shots.scene: 空白规程本翻到一页，只有图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure booklet opened to a page showing only a microbe icon and a lock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么灭活，按这种因子的规程做。

shots.section_title: 做核酸的：按规程先灭活
shots.scene: 核酸和蛋白图标完好地留在管里
shots.prompt_en: Intact DNA and protein icons remain inside the tube after a lock icon appears. No people.
shots.narration: 既要灭活，又要保住要检测的成分。

shots.section_title: 柜内操作，穿好防护，守规程
shots.scene: 小研在安全柜里操作，穿隔离衣戴手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a biological safety cabinet wearing a gown and gloves.
shots.narration: 这些步骤，都在生物安全柜里做。
overlay: 柜内操作，穿好防护，守规程

shots.section_title: 柜内操作，穿好防护，守规程
shots.scene: 手套、隔离衣、护目镜图标和空白规程本
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves, a gown and goggles beside a blank procedure booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 穿好防护，照规程一步步来。

shots.scene: 灭活后的管子留在柜内，进行提取
shots.prompt_en: Inactivated tubes stay inside the cabinet while the female graduate student performs extraction.
shots.narration: 灭活后，核酸提取也在柜内做。

shots.scene: 封好的反应管放进荧光定量仪
shots.prompt_en: Sealed reaction tubes are placed into a real-time PCR instrument with a blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: 提取好，再上机检测。

shots.scene: 仪器屏幕上的空白曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank curve chart icon on the instrument screen. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器会告诉我们，目标在不在。

shots.scene: 不同的微生物图标各配一本不同颜色的规程本
shots.prompt_en: Different microbe icons each paired with a procedure booklet of a different color. No people.
shots.narration: 具体怎么做，看处理的是什么因子。

shots.scene: 王老师和小研对照空白样本处理方案
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student review a blank sample handling plan.
shots.narration: 把每一步写进样本处理方案，

shots.scene: 离心、开管、混匀图标上各放一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Icons of centrifuging, opening a tube and mixing, each under a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 操作步骤本身的风险，也要评估。

shots.scene: 三个圆形箭头首尾相连：放大镜、盾牌、对勾
shots.prompt_en: Three arrows forming a cycle with icons: a magnifier, a shield and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估风险，再实施控制，

shots.scene: 安全柜图标加个人防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon next to protective suit and gloves icons. No people.
shots.narration: 控制靠工程措施，加个人防护。

shots.scene: 检查表打勾，箭头回到起点
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with check marks and an arrow looping back to the start. No people.
shots.narration: 最后检查效果，不断改进。

shots.scene: 已知和未知两类样本管并排
shots.prompt_en: Two sample tubes side by side, one with a check mark and one with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 已知样本、未知样本，都这么管。

shots.scene: 实验室外是城市和人群，中间一道屏障
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory icon with a city and a crowd outside, protected by a barrier line. No people.
shots.narration: 你做好防护，也守住了大家的安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现双层包装、计时器、标签图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of double packaging, a timer and a blank label.
shots.narration: 双层包装，外包装消毒，标识清楚。

shots.scene: 两条岔路：培养和核酸
shots.prompt_en: The two paths icon: one to a culture dish with shields, one to a locked microbe and DNA. No people.
shots.narration: 要培养的最严防护，做核酸的先灭活。

shots.scene: 安全柜、防护用品、规程本
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biological safety cabinet, protective gear and a blank procedure booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内操作，穿好防护，照规程做。

shots.scene: 评估—控制—绩效循环
shots.prompt_en: The assess-control-performance cycle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按最高风险评估，控制，再看效果。

shots.scene: 欣欣、王老师和老周站在样本接收窗口前一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the safety administrator and the older man stand at the sample reception window and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 每一管样本都当真，平安下班，再见！
